name_note: Laedolimicola is a recent genus name; genomes GTDB places here often carry the NCBI names Lachnoclostridium, Candidatus Merdisoma or Anaerosacchariphilus.

sentences.text: Laedolimicola ammoniilytica is a gut bacterial species detected in faecal samples from healthy young adults in Beijing, China.
A panel study reported that this species was among gut microbiota species that may mediate pro-inflammatory and pro-atherosclerotic effects of short-term air pollution exposure.
A study in mice given a high-fat diet and streptozotocin reported decreased Laedolimicola after treatment with a fructan from Achyranthes bidentata.
